Mayawati Removes Akash Anand as National Coordinator

Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) chief Mayawati has removed Akash Anand from his position as National Coordinator. Mayawati stated that Anand is "immature" and not yet ready for the responsibilities. The party also announced that the BSP will contest all upcoming elections independently across India. This decision was made during an all-India meeting of the party.
